say:1:1430234201:1.text: In the past, Prince Ravion has clashed with many powerful lords and ladies in defense of commoners.
say:1:1430234201:1.source_cn: 之前沙利叶殿下为了维护平民可是和很多大贵族起过冲突。
say:1:1430234201:1.male: In the past, Prince Ravion has clashed with many powerful lords and ladies in defense of commoners.
say:1:1430234201:1.female: In the past, Prince Ravion has clashed with many powerful lords and ladies in defense of commoners.

say:2:1430234202:1.text: If you get too close to him, you're likely to be targeted by these nobles.
say:2:1430234202:1.source_cn: 如果和他靠得太近，很可能会被那些大贵族们盯上。
say:2:1430234202:1.male: If you get too close to him, you're likely to be targeted by these nobles.
say:2:1430234202:1.female: If you get too close to him, you're likely to be targeted by these nobles.

say:3:1430234203:1.text: They dare not touch the Queen's own son, but dealing with us lesser nobles is an easy task.
say:3:1430234203:1.source_cn: 他们不敢动女王的亲子，但处理我们这些小贵族，不是轻而易...
say:3:1430234203:1.male: They dare not touch the Queen's own son, but dealing with us lesser nobles is an easy task.
say:3:1430234203:1.female: They dare not touch the Queen's own son, but dealing with us lesser nobles is an easy task.
